name: cursor-follow
title: Cursor Follow
description: Replaces the system cursor inside an area with a spring-smoothed bubble that grows into a text label over elements marked with data-cursor-text.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the area. Give any element a data-cursor-text attribute and the bubble grows into a label over it.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the bubble when it has no label, in pixels.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the bubble off and keeps the system cursor.
